tracks.title: Homeward on This Day
tracks.loreNote: This track originally debuted on the 1996 symphonic rock Christmas album "A Symphony of Snow," becoming a familiar staple for Leo and his family during the holidays. Seven years later, as Leo sat in Sea-Tac Airport on the Wednesday before Thanksgiving 2003—having just escaped a harrowing ordeal—the familiar track began playing over the terminal speakers. The song's profound message of "coming home" hit him like a physical blow. The track was transformed from a simple holiday anthem into a deeply personal, overwhelming declaration of survival, love, and the unyielding devotion of his best friend, Olivia, who was finally bringing him back to the safety of his family.
